newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firms slightly, interbank edges down.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firms slightly, interbank edges down.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed early Wednesday as dollar weakened against the majors but the unit was being traded with a downward bias, dealers said.
The baht was quoted at 26.079/26.084 to the dollar in early trade against 26.085/26.089 late Tuesday. The Thai currency fluctuated between 26.058-26.080 in early dealings.
The interbank rate softened sligtly early as commercial banks, which had already met their reserve requirements, offered aggressively in the market, dealers said.

"The market seemed to be flushed with liquidity. Money that was withdrawn for long weekend started to return to the market and there are also some foreign inflows," a dealer at Thai Farmers Bank said.
"Most commercial banks are well-covered for their reserves requirements and therefore offered the excess money aggressively in the market,' he said.
Thai commercial banks must meet the central bank's mandatory liquidity reserve requirement on the seventh and 22nd of every month.
